messages:
claire: FYI support ticket: tenant triggered console unmask on a 20k-embed job. We leaked lots of raw outputs. Need preflight + per-tenant credits + redact-first enforcement.

 tom: yep. immediate fixes: block persistence for known heavy endpoints by default, add `/inspect/preview` that returns estimate & opt_in_required.

 reza: sampling defaults proposal: persist_rate=0.01, ephemeral_console_only_views=true, endpoints_blocklist=["/v1/embeddings","/v1/bulk/*"]. Also run redactor before any sampling.

 claire: attachment edgecases — base64/pdf/images — have bypassed scrubbers. We need an extractor that strips large blobs before tokenization and flags unknown encodings.

 tom: tokens/handles: unmask should exchange a single-use short TTL handle (HMAC-ed) issued by preview. Store only handle hash. Handle scope limited to that request-id.

 reza: UX: console shows tenant remaining credits, last inspect time, and a dry-run diff of redactions. For bulk jobs require typed confirmation + audit note.

 claire: telemetry metrics: `inspect.preview`, `inspect.handle.issued`, `inspect.unmask.attempt`, `inspect.persisted.count`, `inspect.redact.failures`. Tag by tenant_hash, route, model.

 tom: alerting: page if redact_failures > 0 or if any tenant's persisted_bytes > 4x monthly median for 12h. Auto-suspend inspect for that tenant on spike.

 reza: retention: sampled raw payloads TTL=30d for canary, hashes/provenance indefinite. Key rotation for pseudonymization salts required; include rotation metadata in logs but never the salt.

 claire: rollout: canary 5% tenants with preview-only console + 1% sample. After 2w, evaluate burn + redact failure signals, then expand.

 audit-bot: checklist added: feature-flag `inspect_safe_mode`, preflight endpoint, attachment extractor, redact-first pipeline, sampling config, telemetry hooks, auto-suspend alert.

 reza: ownership: I'll implement preview/handle logic + sampling hooks. tom owns extractor + redactor upgrades. claire drafts RFC + UI mock for dry-run diff.

 claire: will post RFC by Thursday and link mocks. Thanks.
